planets.name: K2-240 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-240 with a 20.5-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-240 c was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-240. Its orbit and size follow Díez Alonso et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
